name: @awcms-one/gerbang
description: This workspace's audit gates, as a package: audit:dokumen (dead links, ADR index, named paths, ADR citations, linked counts), audit:rilis (the waiting changeset backlog), audit:translation (stale/missing Indonesian mirrors), audit:graf (the root knowledge-graph corpus under graphify-out/ — issue #11). Adapted from ahliweb/media-lenterakalteng's packages/gerbang — its remaining content/asset/crawl gates (audit-konten, audit-aset, audit-serapan) are not ported here: this repository has no built content, asset, or crawl surface for them to guard yet. No runtime dependencies of its own.
